## Why are these changes needed?

This PR adds an `UseAgentAsOpenAIChatCompletionEndpoint` API which spins up an OpenAI Chat completion backend powered by an `IAgent`.

In this PR, the following feature is supported
- [x] text response
- [x] streaming response when `IAgent` is `IStreamingAgent`


## Related issue number
Fix #2519
